claims: No. 9 seed Iowa defeated No. 8 seed Clemson 67-61
The game was in the 2026 NCAA Tournament first round
The game was in Tampa, FL
Bennett Stirtz scored 16 points for Iowa
Kael Combs scored 15 points for Iowa
Alvaro Folgueiras scored 14 points for Iowa
R.J. Godfrey scored 15 points for Clemson
Iowa led 51-37 in the second half
Clemson was without its second-leading scorer Carter Welling
Iowa advances to the second round
Iowa will play the winner of top-seeded Florida and No. 16 seed Prairie View A&M
Iowa is in its first year under head coach Ben McCollum
